expectations.text: States the re-uploaded asset breaks every consumer of 2.4.0 because the checksum changed, and that a binary-target URL and its asset must never be replaced
expectations.evidence: Replacing the zip changed its checksum

expectations.text: Prescribes releasing 2.4.1 with a new zip rather than fixing 2.4.0 in place
Reorders the pipeline: build, sign and compute the checksum, create a draft release with the zip attached, then commit `Package.swift` with that checksum and final asset URL, then tag that commit
expectations.evidence: draft release, commit Package.swift, tag that commit

expectations.text: States the tag job must download the draft's asset, verify its checksum against `Package.swift`, then publish the draft, and never rebuild, because XCFramework zips are not byte-reproducible
expectations.evidence: download the draft's asset and verify its checksum... Never rebuild

expectations.text: Adds the plain SemVer `[0-9]*` tag pattern to the workflow trigger, the tag ruleset and the environment rule
expectations.evidence: trigger, ruleset and environment rule all list [0-9]* patterns

expectations.text: States CocoaPods trunk stops accepting new pods and versions on 2026-12-02, with a read-only test run from 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-07
Prescribes publishing the last trunk version and running `pod trunk deprecate BirchwaterKit` before 2026-11-01, noting `--in-favor-of` accepts only another pod name
Prescribes deleting trunk push steps from CI after the cutoff and keeping the podspec only for private spec repos or React Native and Flutter consumers
expectations.evidence: Remove the job after 2026-12-02; private spec repo or RN/Flutter

expectations.text: Recommends code-signing the XCFramework with the Apple Distribution identity and attesting the zip with `actions/attest`
Computes the checksum with `swift package compute-checksum`
States never to move or delete a SwiftPM release tag because `Package.resolved` pins the commit for each version
Recommends enabling GitHub immutable releases so a published release's tag and assets can no longer change
Recommends listing on the Swift Package Index with a `.spi.yml`
